RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_TEST_ID_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT
 test_id,
 test_desc,
 test_group
FROM
 valid_tests
WHERE
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)
and test_group in (select code
 from master_codes where code_type='TSTGP'
 and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10))
order by test_id asc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_TEST_BATCH_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT
distinct
 td.TB_ID,th.insert_dats
FROM test_batch_det td,
 test_batch_hdr th
where td.test_chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and td.tb_id = th.tb_id
and th.insert_dats > sysdate -7
and (td.test_id = :ctrl_blk.test_id or :ctrl_blk.test_id is null)
and td.test_id in ( SELECT
 test_id
 FROM
 valid_tests
WHERE
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)
and test_group in (select code
 from master_codes where code_type='TSTGP'
 and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)))
order by th.insert_dats asc
